description: This file defines configuration options for the iscc_sdk, utilizing pydantic for environment variable management, and includes a class SdkOptions with various configurable parameters related to digital asset processing.

classes.name: SdkOptions
classes.description: A class extending pydantic's BaseSettings to define and validate SDK configuration options, with environment variable support and default values.

methods.name: override
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the current SdkOptions instance with updates applied, validating the new configuration.
